note: 3D step 1 (23 Nov night): the captain's cabin at sunset. World axes: x right, y away from the lens, z up, metres. The stern windows in the back wall (y 3.2); the low sun comes in through them toward the lens. Each shot's camera drifts from 'from[0]' to 'from[1]' over the shot (eased), looking at 'at'; focus on a figure's head or a point.

shots.what: the captain alone at the chart table: he rummages in the papers, they fly off, he straightens and shouts the line toward the boy (off to the right)
over the captain's shoulder on the boy: he looks down, points at the captain's boot, answers, grins
the captain, full figure: he looks down, lifts his boot a few centimetres off the map; his eyes go wide
the captain closer, from the waist up: his face goes red, sweat runs, a sheepish grin
